name: 7-chlorotryptamine
summary: 7-Chlorotryptamine (7-chloro-T, 7-CT, or 7-Cl-T; code name PAL-532) is a serotonin receptor agonist and monoamine releasing agent (MRA) of the tryptamine family. It is a pale yellow solid.8 nM and an EmaxTooltip maximal efficacy of 102%.03 nM for serotonin, 656 nM for norepinephrine, and 1,330 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes.

pharmacology.text: 7-Chlorotryptamine (7-chloro-T, 7-CT, or 7-Cl-T; code name PAL-532) is a serotonin receptor agonist and monoamine releasing agent (MRA) of the tryptamine family. It is a full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 18.8 nM and an Emax of 102%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin releasing agent

summaryZh: 7-氯色胺（7-Cl-T或7-CT，代號PAL-532）是一種血清素受體激動劑單胺釋放劑，化學式為C10H11ClN2，它是一種色胺類化合物。它是淺黃色固體，可由7-氯吲哚-3-甲醛和硝基甲烷反應，再經氫化鋁鋰還原製得。

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors and serotonin release.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體與血清素釋放的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体与血清素释放的实验室研究。

fact.en: It is a pale yellow solid, and in lab tests this single-atom change to tryptamine makes it both a full switch for the 5-HT2A receptor and a potent releaser of serotonin.
fact.zh: 它是淡黃色固體；在實驗室測試中，色胺上這一個原子的改變，就讓它同時成為5-HT2A受體的完全促效劑與強力的血清素釋放劑。
fact.zhHans: 它是淡黄色固体；在实验室测试中，色胺上这一个原子的改变，就让它同时成为5-HT2A受体的完全促效剂与强力的血清素释放剂。
